description: List components from the live component-contract registry. Use it when choosing components by category, trait or rendering context; use structured_data_fetch instead for complete datasets, object_registry for full object definitions, or registry_snapshot for mappings together with traits and objects. Returns component names, categories, readiness labels and availableCategories; detail controls added tags, contexts, regions, traits and evidence. includeInternal exposes hidden registry objects. Readiness evidence retains the build it measured and does not certify a new composition. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#catalog_list; full schema: oods://schemas/catalog_list.input.json.

detail.description: Response detail level. See full schema for details.

includeInternal.description: Also list OODS Foundry's internal (non-business) objects in registry.objects, after the business objects. Without it they are left out and registry.hiddenInternal counts them.

status.description: Filter by legacy static-HTML status only: 'stable' = mapped HTML renderer; 'planned' = HTML fallback. Consult productReality.surfaces for React/Vue, generated-consumer and maturity evidence.

name: catalog_list
title: List Components
